metadata.name: uncertain-save-recovery
metadata.description: Commit one synthetic ordinary UI event in routed Test Genie storage, lose only its browser response, then recover and reopen the same durable event with independent readback.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const original = window.fetch.bind(window); let armed = true; window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; const method = (init && init.method || (typeof input !== 'string' && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (armed && method === 'POST' && url.includes('/api/v1/calendar/events')) { armed = false; const response = await original(input, init); const body = await response.text(); if (!response.ok) return new Response(body, {status:response.status, statusText:response.statusText, headers:response.headers}); throw new Error('synthetic BAS transport: response discarded after server commit (' + response.status + ')'); } return original(input, init); }; return 'one-shot response loss armed for routed event POST'; })()

metadata.label: Arm one-shot response loss after server commit

expected.stringValue: save outcome could not be confirmed

assert.failure_message: UI should represent the committed request as uncertain after its response is lost

metadata.label: Verify ordinary UI uncertain-save recovery state
Use ordinary UI idempotency status recovery

expected.stringValue: The earlier save succeeded: E1 D2 uncertain synthetic, event

assert.failure_message: UI status recovery should resolve the original committed event

metadata.label: Verify status recovery resolves original event

evaluate.expression: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-message"]')?.textContent || ''; const m = text.match(/event ([^,]+), revision (\d+)/); if (!m || m[2] !== '1') throw new Error('recovery message did not expose the original revision-1 identity'); window.__e1D2UncertainEventID = m[1]; return JSON.stringify({id:m[1], revision:Number(m[2])}); })()

metadata.label: Retain recovered durable event ID for independent readback
Reopen recovered event in ordinary UI

assert.failure_message: Reopening should show the same event at revision 1

metadata.label: Verify recovered event revision after reopen

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const id = window.__e1D2UncertainEventID; if (!id) throw new Error('recovered event ID was not retained'); const r = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events/' + encodeURIComponent(id)); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('independent durable readback failed: ' + r.status); const e = await r.json(); if (e.id !== id || e.revision !== 1 || e.title !== 'E1 D2 uncertain synthetic') throw new Error('recovery did not resolve exactly the committed durable event'); const q = new URLSearchParams({start_local_date:'2000-01-01', end_local_date:'2199-12-31'}); const listResponse = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events?' + q); if (!listResponse.ok) throw new Error('independent list readback failed'); const list = await listResponse.json(); const matches = (list.events || []).filter(x => x.title === 'E1 D2 uncertain synthetic'); if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one event after recovery; found ' + matches.length); return JSON.stringify({id:e.id, revision:e.revision, title:e.title, durableCount:matches.length}); })()

metadata.label: Independent durable readback confirms exactly one event
